objective: Select the strongest checkpoint for classifying product reviews into five sentiment classes, judged on held-out accuracy and calibration.
rubric: Prefer the checkpoint with the higher held-out accuracy; if accuracy is within one point, prefer the better-calibrated one. Report a tie only when neither condition breaks the pair.

contestants.summary: RoBERTa-base fine-tuned for three epochs on the labeled review split.
DistilBERT fine-tuned for five epochs with class-weighted loss.
DeBERTa-v3-small fine-tuned for three epochs with label smoothing.
A BiLSTM with attention trained from scratch on the review split.
